prompt.en: The Royal Commission on Bilingualism and Biculturalism, set up in 1963, led to which law?
prompt.fr: La Commission royale d'enquête sur le bilinguisme et le biculturalisme, créée en 1963, a mené à quelle loi?

options.fr: La Loi sur les langues officielles de 1969.
La Loi canadienne sur la santé.
La Loi sur la citoyenneté de 1947.

explanation.en: Parliament set up the commission in 1963, and its work led to the Official Languages Act in 1969.
explanation.fr: Le Parlement a créé la commission en 1963, et ses travaux ont mené à la Loi sur les langues officielles en 1969.

source.quote: In 1963 Parliament established the Royal Commission on Bilingualism and Biculturalism. This led to the Official Languages Act (1969), which guarantees French and English services in the federal government across Canada.

verification.evidence: In 1963 Parliament established the Royal Commission on Bilingualism and Biculturalism. This led to the Official Languages Act (1969)
